adjudication.rationale: In the new `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` handler, `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` can throw on malformed bodies, and `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` can also throw (e.g., bad ciphertext or missing/empty `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` due to `|| ""`). There is no `try/catch` or shared `defaultHandler` wrapper here, so these errors will propagate as unhandled exceptions and result in a generic 500 response rather than a controlled JSON error contract.
